text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Rose Kingdom and I had one
more important errand to attend to today.
Namely—

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Please welcome the ambassador
for our new jewelry series, 'King and Knight'!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the introduction. I am Fine Motion, the ambassador.
And this is my security detail—my 'Knight'.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for joining us today.
And as for our other pair of ambassadors—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am Rose Kingdom, newly appointed as your ambassador.
And this is my 'Knight'—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom and I were recently appointed as ambassadors for a certain jewelry brand.
Today is the unveiling ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pinned to my chest right now... is an absurdly
massive piece of fine jewelry: a brooch.
As for how this came to pass—

text_block_list.name: Jewelry Brand Rep
text_block_list.text:
This season, our brand will unveil a new
jewelry line under the theme of 'The King and the Knight.'

text_block_list.name: Jewelry Brand Rep
text_block_list.text: Word is that your relationship is truly like that of a 'King and Knight.' I felt you would be the perfect fit for this theme, which is why I extended this offer!

text_block_list.name: Jewelry Brand Rep
text_block_list.text:
For Lady Rose Kingdom, we have selected this diamond brooch,
which will also be featured in the project's key visual.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry Brand Rep
text_block_list.text:
And for you, my "knight" and Trainer...
I was considering a piece of jewelry featuring sapphire, which symbolizes unwavering loyalty.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a splendid idea.
...Is that brooch over there one of the candidates?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hmm... If it is something befitting him—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hmm... If it is something befitting her—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
What do you think of that blue sapphire over there?
The setting should be adorned with diamonds, of course.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry Brand Rep
text_block_list.text: You have discerning taste. While the diamond is a modest 0.1 carats, its classic design makes it a piece of true refinement.
choice_data_list: However, I fear it may be a bit too luxurious for me...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Do not be so modest. ......Mm.
That vivid sapphire over there is quite splendid as well.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry Brand Rep
text_block_list.text:
An exquisite choice as always, Your Highness!
This sapphire is the finest quality
among our 'Knight' jewelry collection—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, here I was wearing the finest sapphire... but honestly, the sheer luxury of it had my legs shaking with nerves.
choice_data_list: (The weight on my chest feels heavy...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to stiffen up.
For what I have chosen is truly befitting... ――

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: Could there be something out of place?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No...
It is fine. Hold your head high.

text_block_list.name: Jewelry Brand Rep
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for your hard work! That concludes today's unveiling.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You on the podium... were truly wonderful.
Just as I thought, it suits you so well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You are so earnest and strict, always standing quietly
in the background... yet you conceal such a kind heart.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I believed iolite
was so fitting.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness... Such gracious words are far more than I deserve—
I hardly know what to say...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—The gem language of iolite was...
'sincerity,' if I recall correctly.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(The gem itself is not particularly costly.
Yet... Fine by no means holds
her knight in 'cheap' regard.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(There must be "heart" behind such discerning eyes.
That is precisely why that bodyguard...—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ! Ah—about your... well, that brooch.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wish to retract what I said about it being suited to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Had my sheer nervousness caused me to commit some terrible faux pas?
Even after she had gone to the trouble of picking this outfit for me...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, that is not it. My apologies.
...My assessment was simply too naive.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There must be an ornament far more truly suited to you—
one that brings out the beauty of your inner self as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Indeed, I have reconsidered.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I want to give it proper thought once more...
and present it with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Will you wait for me?
My peerless knight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sincere gaze warms my heart.
To receive such solicitous care... I almost worry it is far more than I deserve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I started to say, "I would be delighted—" before hastily catching myself.
After all, having someone care for me like this was already more than enough.
choice_data_list: Forgive me for speaking so presumptuously.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is not presumptuous in the least.
If it brings you joy, then I am delighted as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Please, look forward to it.
I shall present you with something truly exceptional——without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To have you trouble yourself so deeply on our account feels far too presumptuous.
Your kind words alone are more than enough—"
I bow my head as I speak.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to hold back. Or rather...
it would be more accurate to say I wish for you to indulge my whim.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wish to select it myself. Above all else, what my dear retainer wears—should be chosen by my own hands.
